name: What should I consider when choosing a style of window casing?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a style of window casing?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a window casing style, consider your home's architectural period and existing interior trim to ensure a cohesive look. Options range from simple, modern profiles to more ornate, traditional designs. The width of the casing can also impact the perceived size of your windows. As a decision factor, think about whether you want the casing to blend in or stand out as a decorative feature. Discussing your home's style and your aesthetic goals with a professional installer, like those at Maine Results, Inc., can help you make an informed choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a casing style that matches your home's architecture and existing trim. Consider width and whether you want it to blend or be a feature.
